page.layout: One printed page: title page, all text in one centred block, with a rule, a Bible quotation, a printers' ornament, and an imprint at the foot. Handwritten annotations in the margins and over the text are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: Manete in me, & ego in vobis : sicut palmes non potest ferre
fructum à semetipso, id est, nisi manserit in
vite : ita nec vos, nisi in me manseritis.

page.notes: Handwritten ink annotations (a crossed-out name at upper left and right, "Ex lib." at left, and a signature "Me Georgij Mellagon" at right) are not printed and are omitted. The ornament between the rules is a row of four crowned emblems (flower, harp, fleur-de-lis, thistle-like device), not text.
